references.text: Further elaboration on unclean creeping things that move on the ground, including those that crawl on their bellies or walk on four or more feet
The exhortation not to make oneself unclean by these creeping things, linked to God's holiness
A parallel list of unclean animals in Deuteronomy that the Israelites were not to eat
Isaiah's prophecy mentioning mice among abominations eaten by those who reject the Lord
Mice mentioned in connection with the Philistines' guilt offering, showing that mice were regarded as unclean and troublesome creatures
